column2: Paano mag-create ng Context sa React?

column4: const theme = useContext(ThemeContext); — i-access ang value mula sa nearest Provider

column2: Paano gumamit ng useReducer para sa complex state?
column4: const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, initialState); dispatch({type: 'ADD', payload: item});
function reducer(state, action) { switch(action.type) { case 'ADD': return {...state, items: [...state.items, action.payload]}; } }

column2: Paano mag-combine ng useContext at useReducer?
column4: I-provide ang dispatch at state gamit ang Context: <AppContext.Provider value={{state, dispatch}}>
